Subject: Conference asset pack + demo flow for Velocity Summit (draft)

Hi Olivia / Velocity team —

Thanks again for the slot at Velocity. We want to lock the collateral set for the booth and our 30-minute talk this week so we can hand off assets to design by Thursday. Draft checklist below — please confirm any missing items or hard constraints (file types, sizes, deadlines):

- One-pager (product summary + pricing bullets) — 1 page
- Customer case study (TangoHealth, 300–400 words + quote + headshot)
- 2-slide demo flow (slide 1: flow overview; slide 2: live demo steps + talking points)
- Demo script / playbook (4–6 minute core demo + fallback flows)
- Booth banner art (logo + 2 key value props)
- Speaker bio and headshot (Samir)

Attachments: Sponsor_Booth_Specs.pdf (from you) — can you confirm final banner dimensions and bleed?

Monica / Hannah — can you review the checklist and flag any gaps on the PM/product side? Dev, last call: are there any limitations on demo steps we need to avoid on stage (networking, live DB connections)?

Target milestones:
- Asset list locked: Tue 9/21 EOD
- Drafts in design: Thu 9/23
- Final assets uploaded to Velocity portal: Mon 9/28

Thanks — happy to sync briefly if easier.

—
Dylan Brooks
Senior Events & Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

Thanks — I reviewed the checklist and pushed a couple of product edits inline. Key changes:

- One-pager: add a short comparison box (Typical infra vs Redwood Inference) and a 2-sentence customer outcome (revenue or latency stat).
- Demo script: reorder to show failure/fallback earlier (so audience sees resilience story first), then deep dive into cost controls and observability (30s examples).
- Case study: use Samir's quote verbatim once he signs off; include a 2-line technical appendix for the CS team.

I've attached a quick revision of the one-pager with suggested copy (RWI_onepager_v2.pdf). Please treat as copy-only — design will typeset.

Attachment: RWI_onepager_v2.pdf [PDF — copy edits]

Dev — confirm we can run the local laptop demo with a cached model and simulated upstream outage (we should avoid depending on TangoHealth environment).
